patterns: APPSC asks single firsts: first state to set up a Lokayukta (Maharashtra), first Lokpal Bill year (1968), first AP Lokayukta (Justice A. Sambasiva Rao).
Recurring dates: Act in force 16 Jan 2014 vs assent 1 Jan 2014; first Lokpal P.C. Ghose (2019).
State-specific traps: Rajasthan cut Lokayukta tenure 8 to 5 years; AP Lokayukta 'not an interpreter of the Constitution'.
UPSC/UKPSC test Act details: selection committee (no RS Chairman), min age 45, PM coverage, public servants abroad covered.
App MCQs cover the Act thoroughly but the topic's CVC half is almost absent; several 2026 current-affairs items exceed PYQ depth.
